spans.text: [21] AR: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ وَأَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًۭا EN: Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others.

spans.text: But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.

entries.subject: your Lord
entries.object: decreed that you not worship except Him

spans.text: [23] AR: ۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّۢ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا EN: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment.

entries.task_id: your lord|is|most knowing of what is within yourselves
entries.description: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves
entries.subject: Your Lord
entries.object: most knowing of what is within yourselves

spans.text: [25] AR: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِى نُفُوسِكُمْ ۚ إِن تَكُونُوا۟ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورًۭا EN: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves.

folded.subject: and man
folded.object: ever hasty

spans.text: [11] AR: وَيَدْعُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلْخَيْرِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَجُولًۭا EN: And man supplicates for evil as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.

folded.id: and never|has|the gift of your lord been restricted
folded.subject: And never
folded.object: the gift of your Lord been restricted

spans.text: And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted.

folded.id: and to|destroy|what they had taken over with [total] destruction
folded.subject: and to
folded.object: what they had taken over with [total] destruction

spans.text: Then when the final promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the temple in Jerusalem, as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.

[16] AR: وَإِذَآ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا۟ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَٰهَا تَدْمِيرًۭا EN: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.

folded.id: and we|conveyed|to the children of israel in the scripture that
folded.subject: And We
folded.object: to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that

spans.text: [4] AR: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا EN: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness.

folded.id: and we|erased|the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]
folded.subject: and We
folded.object: the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]

spans.text: [12] AR: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيْنِ ۖ فَمَحَوْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةًۭ لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ فَصَّلْنَٰهُ تَفْصِيلًۭا EN: And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time].

folded.id: and we|gave|moses the scripture and made it a guidance for the children of israel that you not take other than me as disposer of affairs
folded.subject: And We
folded.object: Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs

spans.text: [2] AR: وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هُدًۭى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِى وَكِيلًۭا EN: And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs,
[6] AR: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَٰكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا EN: Then We gave back to you a return victory over them.

folded.id: and we|have|made hell
folded.subject: And We
folded.object: made Hell

spans.text: And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed."
Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished.

folded.id: and we|have|made the night and day two signs
folded.subject: And We
folded.object: made the night and day two signs

spans.text: [12] AR: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيْنِ ۖ فَمَحَوْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةًۭ لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ فَصَّلْنَٰهُ تَفْصِيلًۭا EN: And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time].

folded.id: and we|reinforced|you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower
folded.subject: And We
folded.object: you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower

spans.text: And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower

folded.id: and we|will|produce for him on the day of resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open
folded.subject: and We
folded.object: produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open

spans.text: [13] AR: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلْزَمْنَٰهُ طَٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِى عُنُقِهِۦ ۖ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبًۭا يَلْقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا EN: And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.

folded.id: everything we|have|set out in detail
folded.subject: everything We
folded.object: set out in detail

spans.text: And everything We have set out in detail.

folded.id: exalted|is|he who took his servant by night from al-masjid al-haram to al-masjid al-aqsa
folded.subject: Exalted
folded.object: He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ EN: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs.

folded.id: he|is|the hearing
folded.subject: He
folded.object: the Hearing

spans.text: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

folded.id: how many|have|we destroyed from the generations after noah
folded.subject: how many
folded.object: We destroyed from the generations after Noah

spans.text: [17] AR: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ نُوحٍۢ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًۭا EN: And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah.

folded.id: how we|have|favored [in provision] some of them over others
folded.subject: how We
folded.object: favored [in provision] some of them over others

spans.text: [21] AR: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ وَأَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًۭا EN: Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others.

folded.subject: It
folded.object: expected

spans.text: [8] AR: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ ۚ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا ۘ وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا EN: [Then Allah said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you.

folded.id: it|will|be said]
folded.subject: It
folded.object: be said]

spans.text: [14] AR: ٱقْرَأْ كِتَٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًۭا EN: [It will be said], "Read your record.

folded.id: of burdens|will|bear the burden of another
folded.subject: of burdens
folded.object: bear the burden of another

spans.text: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another.

folded.id: person we|have|imposed his fate upon his neck
folded.subject: person We
folded.object: imposed his fate upon his neck

spans.text: [13] AR: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلْزَمْنَٰهُ طَٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِى عُنُقِهِۦ ۖ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبًۭا يَلْقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا EN: And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.

folded.id: sufficient|is|yourself against you this day as accountant
folded.subject: Sufficient
folded.object: yourself against you this Day as accountant

spans.text: Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant."
And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Acquainted and Seeing.

folded.id: surroundings we|have|blessed
folded.subject: surroundings We
folded.object: blessed

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ EN: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs.

folded.id: that which|is|most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward
folded.subject: that which
folded.object: most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward

spans.text: [9] AR: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَهْدِى لِلَّتِى هِىَ أَقْوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًۭا كَبِيرًۭا EN: Indeed, this Qur'an guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward.

folded.id: the hereafter|is|greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction
folded.subject: the Hereafter
folded.object: greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction

spans.text: But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.

folded.id: those we|carried|[in the ship] with noah
folded.subject: those We
folded.object: [in the ship] with Noah

spans.text: [3] AR: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبْدًۭا شَكُورًۭا EN: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah.

folded.id: we|extend|- to these and to those - from the gift of your lord
folded.subject: We
folded.object: - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord

spans.text: [20] AR: كُلًّۭا نُّمِدُّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنْ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُورًا EN: To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord.

folded.id: we|hasten|for him from it what we will to whom we intend
folded.subject: We
folded.object: for him from it what We will to whom We intend

spans.text: [18] AR: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا مَذْمُومًۭا مَّدْحُورًۭا EN: Whoever should desire the immediate - We hasten for him from it what We will to whom We intend.

folded.id: we|have|prepared for them a painful punishment
folded.subject: We
folded.object: prepared for them a painful punishment

spans.text: [10] AR: وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا EN: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment.

folded.id: we|sent|against you servants of ours - those of great military might
folded.subject: We
folded.object: against you servants of Ours - those of great military might

spans.text: [5] AR: فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ أُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًۭا لَّنَآ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ فَجَاسُوا۟ خِلَٰلَ ٱلدِّيَارِ ۚ وَكَانَ وَعْدًۭا مَّفْعُولًۭا EN: So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.

folded.id: we|sent|your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the temple in jerusalem
folded.subject: We
folded.object: your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the temple in Jerusalem

spans.text: Then when the final promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the temple in Jerusalem, as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.

folded.id: we|will|return [to punishment]
folded.subject: We
folded.object: return [to punishment]

spans.text: But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment].

folded.id: when we|intend|to destroy a city
folded.subject: when We
folded.object: to destroy a city

spans.text: [16] AR: وَإِذَآ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا۟ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَٰهَا تَدْمِيرًۭا EN: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.

folded.id: which he|will|[enter to] burn
folded.subject: which he
folded.object: [enter to] burn

spans.text: Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished.

folded.id: while he|is|a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by allah]
folded.subject: while he
folded.object: a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allah]

spans.text: [19] AR: وَمَنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًۭا EN: But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allah].

folded.id: whoever|is|guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul
folded.subject: Whoever
folded.object: guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul

spans.text: [15] AR: مَّنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًۭا EN: Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul.

folded.id: would we|punish|until we sent a messenger
folded.subject: would We
folded.object: until We sent a messenger

spans.text: And never would We punish until We sent a messenger.

folded.id: you|will|surely cause corruption on the earth twice
folded.subject: You
folded.object: surely cause corruption on the earth twice

spans.text: [4] AR: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا EN: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness.

folded.id: your lord|has|decreed that you not worship except him
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: decreed that you not worship except Him

spans.text: [23] AR: ۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّۢ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا EN: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment.

folded.id: your lord|is|most knowing of what is within yourselves
folded.subject: Your Lord
folded.object: most knowing of what is within yourselves

spans.text: [25] AR: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِى نُفُوسِكُمْ ۚ إِن تَكُونُوا۟ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورًۭا EN: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves.

folded.id: your lord|will|have mercy upon you
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: have mercy upon you

spans.text: [8] AR: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ ۚ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا ۘ وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا EN: [Then Allah said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you.
